steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
List. Asset states, open work orders and open permits are stacked for the next shift.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Work order with no owner
findings.fix: Assign an owner before the shift ends

findings.title: Asset state with no time
findings.fix: Record the time of the state

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] permit-open-1.md:12  Permit with no expiry.
       Fix: Set the permit's expiry.
[medium] wo-open-1.md:19  Work order with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner before the shift ends.
[low] asset-state-a.md:26  Asset state with no time.
       Fix: Record the time of the state.
Not checked: Assets not in the log.
pros: Checks a permit with no expiry, a work order with no owner, and an asset state with no time.
cons: Not checked: Assets not in the log.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ind-shift-handover skill on the records for this review.
